Wider scan (grader|graded|grading|verifier|checker|evaluat|assess|benchmark|scored|points|oracle|golden|solution|solve.sh|app_context|scoring|harbor|turing|openrouter|z-ai|mcp|likert|functional|polish|visual|render|constraints|probe|0.6|0.2 and ALLCAPS-HYPHEN probe literals): no grader reference; only 'basis points' (hireops_rules.md:77) and 'HOME points to' (:420). Other lexical near-misses are domain language: 'there is no test clock to wind forward' (hireops_rules.md:60), 'The budget gate' (:170), 'by the same test commit applies in section 11' (:522). Criterion ids: extracted 166 id/name values from tests/**/judge.toml and scoring.toml (all hro_* style); none occurs in the brief or either note. Dimension names, weights, judge model, /tests paths, tool names and sentinels are absent. Verbatim overlap: word n-gram comparison of every tests/*.md and *.toml against the brief and notes. Longest shared run is 10 words, 'the offending field when the explanation sits at that field' (hireops_rules.md:555 vs tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:41), which is a shared requirement statement, not criterion text copied at length; other runs are 7-8 words (e.g. 'each member's old/new run-rate, signing adjustment and' vs functional/prompt.md; the demo account list vs app_context.md, which the brief must state). No long verbatim overlap. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot learn probe values, criterion ids or weighting from the public files, and a conforming alternative is not disadvantaged by anything here. Limits: this is a manual source review; the private check-instruction-hygiene.py was not executed, so whether its vocabulary list trips on the literal 'weight' at hireops_rules.md:20 or 'test clock' at :60 is unmeasured and belongs to the deterministic review. No runtime evidence is required for this row.
